about:
Employees' Bakery Machinery Inc. (EBM) is based in Billings, Montana. The company has been active in the bakery equipment sector for more than 20 years, though its exact founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

EBM supplies and reconditions commercial bakery machinery. Its inventory focuses on equipment for cookies, crackers, frozen dough, cereal bars, cakes, muffins, pies, and other sweet goods. The company reconditions a range of machines including dough depositors, rotary moulders, wire cuts, mixers, chocolate enrobers, guillotine and bar cutters, sheeters, and dough feed systems. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

The company serves commercial bakeries and food manufacturers producing cookies, crackers, frozen dough, cereal bars, cakes, muffins, pies, and sweet goods. Its featured equipment list includes mixers from Shaffer, Peerless, and APV; depositors from Fedco and AMF; kettles from Groen and Feldmeier; slicers from FoodTools; sandwiching machines from Peters; ovens from Gemini and IJ White; and a variety of pans, tanks, and pumps.

EBM emphasizes fair pricing, one-on-one service, and confidentiality agreements with clients. The company states that its unparalleled service, competitive prices, and overall value are why customers return.
